photos.c: Bert East (centre) had difficulty in even making the start of the London Transport '2' on July 6th at Acton, but mention the word "handicap" and he's off like a shot! Ray Middleton thinks it's a laugh beating the 2 miles record of a No.11 bus, while Wil Wesch gets on with winning at well over speed-limit
